wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 08-009 wires the player death/reborn/transition path via one src/vanilla facade (wireDeathRebornAndTransitions.ts) re-exporting the read-only implement-death-and-reborn-flow (stepVanillaDeathThink, PLAYER_STATE_LIVE/DEAD/REBORN 0/1/2, VANILLA_DEAD_VIEWHEIGHT_FIXED 6*FRACUNIT / DROP 1*FRACUNIT, VANILLA_DEATHMATCH_RESPAWN_DELAY_TICS 10, DeathThink I/O + PlayerState type alias) and playerSpawn (playerReborn/createPlayer/bringUpWeapon/setupPsprites + NUMWEAPONS 9/NUMAMMO 4/NUMCARDS 6/NUMPOWERS 6/NUMPSPRITES 2). VANILLA_DEATH_REBORN_INVARIANTS pins five rules (3-value player state; dead view drop+clamp at 6; reborn-only-on-use; playerReborn starting loadout; 10-tic DM respawn delay). The playerSpawn const enums (PlayerState/WeaponType/AmmoType/PowerType/CardType/PsprNum) are not re-exported (verbatimModuleSyntax); the death-flow PlayerState 0|1|2 type alias is surfaced instead (resolving the PlayerState name collision between the two modules). The focused test exercises real stepVanillaDeathThink view-drop/clamp/reborn-on-use behavior, the constants, the frozen manifest, the ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral. This step became eligible after 08-008 completed (itself unblocked by the 442975e cycle fix).
